title: structure
description: A relationship diagram you design: one column per party, rows (bands) you name yourself, boxes that place roles and teams in a band, and plain lines between cells.

id.description: Unique id: lower-case letters and numbers joined by hyphens, e.g. partnership.

kind.description: Optional label in your own words, e.g. Partnership, Market or Sub-programme. It has no built-in meaning.

summary.description: One or two sentences about this diagram.

status.description: Optional review status: under-review (the default) while it may still change, or agreed once it is settled. Shown as a badge wherever the diagram appears.

main.description: true for the one diagram that covers the whole company or partnership. A model with diagrams has exactly one.

related.description: The ids of related structures. Each relation is shown from both sides.

bands.description: The rows, top to bottom. A band can hold sub-bands, one level deep.

id.description: Id, unique within this structure: lower-case letters and numbers joined by hyphens, e.g. leadership.

opens.description: Optional id of a structure that this band opens (drill down).

bands.description: Optional sub-bands, top to bottom. A band with sub-bands holds no boxes of its own.

id.description: Id, unique within this structure: lower-case letters and numbers joined by hyphens, e.g. harbour.

opens.description: Optional id of a structure that this sub-band opens (drill down).

bands.description: Not allowed: bands can be nested only one level deep.

boxes.description: The boxes, in order. Each places one role or one team in a band, in the column of its party.

band.description: The id of the band (or sub-band) the box sits in.

role.description: The id of the role in this box. Use role or team, not both.

team.description: The id of the team in this box. Use role or team, not both.

name.description: Optional text, e.g. the person who holds the role, or TBA.

note.description: Optional extra text, e.g. a grade or another title.

status.description: How this element differs from today.

today.description: How it works today, shown next to the future state.

lines.description: Plain lines between two cells, each given as a band and a party. Lines have no direction.

party.description: The id of the party (the column).

to.description: The other end of the line.

party.description: The id of the party (the column).

label.description: Optional text shown with the line, e.g. Joint steering.

status.description: How this element differs from today.

today.description: How it works today, shown next to the future state.
